name: metabob
description: Metabob code intelligence: CPG structure, impact analysis, co-change prediction, cross-agent findings, and org-wide design memory. Bundles the metabob MCP server and the sequencing skill. Setup: the substrate installer writes your API key and endpoint to ~/.substrate/config.json; otherwise set METABOB_API_KEY and METABOB_ENDPOINT. Check the connection with `npx @metabob/mcp attach --check`.
